text: As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, ethical questions are more important than ever. One major concern is bias. If AI systems learn from unfair data, they can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating everyone equally, so developers must test their systems carefully. Privacy is another key issue, because AI often collects and uses personal information. People should know how their data is used. Transparency also matters: we need to understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means putting human values first. Companies and governments must work together to create clear rules that protect people and build trust in technology.
